|value = 100 |gprice = Not Sold }} The '''Magnet Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be obtained as a [[Monsters|monster]] drop or by breaking crates and barrels in [[The Mines]] at Floors 40+ and the [[Skull Cavern]] at Floors 1-39. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 20 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game. The Magnet Ring may be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] at [[Fishing]] skill 2+, but only if your [[Luck]] is buffed (higher magnitude buffs increase your chances). The Magnet Ring increases the player's [[Magnetism|magnetic radius]] by two tiles.
